editing.adaptation: Image-token conditions, increasing time and midpoint Euler; not a reproduced paper result.
editing.source_velocity_model: same frozen dog decoder conditioned on source cat tokens; experimental

interpretation: The three main methods share exact v9 dog tokens and conditioning masks. Source RGB supplies spatial structure through VAE latents. The source field uses cat tokens in the dog decoder, which is outside its training domain. Watch for unchanged cats, reference copying, lost pose and malformed anatomy. No automatic quality pass; generated-image UMAP is descriptive only.

noise_protocol.baseline: Original v9 per-query noise, hash-checked before decoding.
noise_protocol.flow_edit: Fresh independent step noises; each draw shared between source/target fields. This is a different stochastic protocol from noise generation and source denoising.
noise_protocol.source_denoise: Same original noise mixed with the deterministic source VAE latent.

pixel_diagnostics.interpretation: RGB MAE is a change/copy diagnostic, not a translation score.

quality_review.rule: Inspect every column at native resolution. Accept only if clarity AND dog realism AND source pose/expression/color improve without greater reference copying or facial artifacts. A sharper cat-like image, or a retrieved dog, is not successful translation.

umap.feature_space: Generated RGB re-encoded by the frozen encoder; all output patches; not the input conditioning tokens.
umap.interpretation: No generated or held-out query points fit either reducer. All output patches are re-encoded; corresponding grid indices are display records, not verified semantic correspondences. UMAP is not a semantic score, and coordinates cannot be compared between rows or separately fitted runs.
